verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents its own Job Builder, a graphical interface for generating and trying out API requests. A sandbox API lets users run unlimited test jobs without spending credits, so requests can be executed safely. However, the evidence never describes the API reference itself as interactive, with runnable examples embedded per endpoint. Missing for 10: an evidenced interactive API reference with inline runnable examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Job Builder experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: It allows you to generate and try out requests using a graphical interface.
The sandbox API allows you to perform unlimited jobs and tasks without consuming your credits.
